name: memo-bridge
description: Private MCP for Memo Labs: inspect a Mac and a Netcup VPS read-only, browse registered projects, and coordinate parallel AI work sessions (workspaces, task leases, checkpoints) without relying on the Sentinel X commercial hub.

interface.shortDescription: Mac + VPS status and work coordination
interface.longDescription: Inspect the Memo Labs Mac and VPS with fixed read-only probes, list registered projects, and coordinate work between sessions: open a workspace, claim a task, record pushed checkpoints. Coordinator state stays in a private local store; no shell, no project file writes. Requires a local Mac runtime and SSH access to the VPS.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the status of my Mac and VPS through Memo Bridge.
